summary: This note is a short biography of Richard Šmehlík, a Czech former professional ice hockey defenceman who played in the National Hockey League. It records his birth date and his draft selection by the Buffalo Sabres in the 1990 NHL Entry Draft.
one_line: Czech former NHL ice hockey defenceman born January 23, 1970, drafted 97th overall by the Buffalo Sabres in 1990.
key_facts: Richard Šmehlík was born on January 23, 1970.
Richard Šmehlík is a Czech former professional ice hockey defenceman.
Richard Šmehlík played in the National Hockey League (NHL).
Richard Šmehlík was drafted in the fifth round of the 1990 NHL Entry Draft.
Richard Šmehlík was selected 97th overall in the 1990 NHL Entry Draft.
Richard Šmehlík was drafted by the Buffalo Sabres.
